title: Swim.com Workout Weekly Workout Time Trend
dataSources: Swim.com workouts (`swimcom:workout`), MySwimPro sessions (`myswimpro:session`), pool lap logs (`pool:lap`), and swim meet results (`swim:meet`).
app: Swim.com workout exports, MySwimPro session logs, pool lap counters, swim meet results, and interval pace trackers forwarded to Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=swimcom:workout workout_minutes=*
| bin _time span=1w
| stats avg(workout_minutes) as avg_duration, max(workout_minutes) as worst_duration by _time
| sort _time
description: Trends the average and worst workout time for Swim.com workout events each week.
value: Weekly timing trends show whether a process is becoming slower, more erratic, or healthier over time.
implementation: Capture workout_minutes on each event and review weekly averages plus worst cases during your personal ops review.
visualization: Line chart of weekly average workout time with markers for the worst week.
grandmaExplanation: It ranks whether Swim.com workout tasks are taking longer than they used to and where the slow weeks were.
